nieuw.titel: Make Cathayan cannons an early shooting priority

nieuw.waarom: He notes that the artillery piece has only three wounds when shot, while charging it means facing Stand and Shoot and then fighting the Ogre crew. He fears the opening volley from cannons that can shoot twice.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: An immediate threat such as Jade Lancers approaching your shooters may change target priority; he also allows that a particularly powerful combat unit could attack the cannon.
